entities.text: High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
For the Informant : Mr. Ashish Verma, Advocate
---
04/16.02.2024

Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned A.P.P and learned counsel for the
informant.

2. The petitioner has approached this Court for grant of regular bail in connection with Musabani
P.S.Case No. 20 of 2023, corresponding to Special Pocso Case No. 34 of 2023, registered for the
offence under Sections 376(2)(n) of I.P.C and Sections 4 and 6 of the Pocso Act, pending in the
Court of learned Special Pocso Judge, Pocso, Jamshedpur.

3.  Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that earlier the bail application of this petitioner was withdrawn by this Court and subsequently after coming of the report of DNA, petitioner has again preferred this application and he submits that as per the DNA Report the petitioner is not biological father of the child; as such he may be enlarged on bail.
4. Learned A.P.P. and learned counsel for the informant opposed the prayer for bail of the petitioner 5. Having regard to the facts of the case and the nature of allegation made against this petitioner,
coupled with the statement of the victim girl recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C and also the fact that the case is fixed for evidence, I am not inclined to enlarge this petitioner on bail.

Accordingly,
his prayer for bail is rejected.
Consequently, the bail application is dismissed.
